lines.en: label sportswars4:
scene sportstrivia1
: Before our next contest begins, I’d like to ask for a moment of silence in remembrance of our dearly departed Sana.
: May her soul find peace in this cruel, dark world.
: You two do know she’s still alive, right?
scene sportstrivia2
: She’s just...eggier than normal now.
: Uta, would you mind explaining again why I was elected to compete in this contest instead of Nodoka?
: Because we’ve already had a Nodoka vs Makoto trivia battle and we all know how that went last time.
: But...we won last time. Shouldn’t that be a thing we’re trying to, you know, repeat?
scene sportstrivia3
: Yes, Io. But at what cost? If Makoto dies from embarrassment after being decimated a second time, Imani will just have to work harder to get all of our worksheets out and we can’t do that to her.
: It’s good to know that I’m just as much of a priority as ever.
: Uta’s obviously kidding, Makoto. Nobody actually wants you to die. Io was probably just chosen now because this event requires minimal participation and she’s actually still here.
: It doesn’t matter to me who I compete against. First and foremost, I just want to redeem myself for my prior performance. And Io being my opponent just means I’ll have an easier time doing that.
scene sportstrivia4
: Just because I don’t want to do this doesn’t mean I’m going to be bad at it. I take studying pretty seriously, you know.
: I do know. I help Miss Imai grade the homework when I have spare time and you’re consistently better than almost everyone else in class.

: Then what’s with the “Oh, it’ll be easier for me if it’s Io” stuff? You can’t just compliment me and insult me at the same time. Especially when my brain can’t process compliments in the first place.
: I just mean that you’ll be an easier opponent than Nodoka. And I’m pretty sure everyone here would agree with that.
: Nodoka is rather...unfair to compete with in competitions like this.
scene sportstrivia5
: Miss Imai, why do we even have a competition like this in the first place? This has nothing to do with sports. Can we just end it in a tie and still earn our participation points so I can leave?
scene sportstrivia6
: Didn’t Rika go over that in the preamble? I threw in a few mental contests since some of you see physical activity as a weak point.
: Granted, you weren’t one of the girls I had in mind when I decided to do that, but your floormates have made this bed and now you must lie in it.
: I’m sure you’ll be fine, Io. Makoto’s really smart, but Rika’s really great at trivia too and Rika is...well, Rika is Rika.
: Who the fuck is Rika?
scene sportstrivia7
: Woah, when the hell did you get here?
: A few minutes after the cyclops died and I’m already bored as shit.
: Yumi! Welcome to the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB! You didn’t see Maya anywhere on the way, did you? Because she kind of vanished out of nowhere and we sort of need her here.
: Yeah, I wouldn’t count on that. Saw her decked out in her school uniform like ten minutes before I got here. Doubt she’s coming back.
scene sportstrivia8
: Oh, she better have a damn good excuse for this.
: Mwahahah! Between Maya’s disappearance and the fact that the second floor is already off to a commanding lead, you must be shaking in your gym shoes right now!
scene sportstrivia9
: There’s been one competition. You have one point.
: Yes, but if there’s anything I know about percentages, it’s that that is 100%% more than you guys have.
scene sportstrivia10
: That...is not how percentages work.
: Wait, it’s not?
: Leave her alone. She’s trying.
: No, I think Uta’s actually right, guys — 0 plus 100%% is 1, ain’t it?
: Her too.
: How is this school still operational when no one has learned anything at any point here?
: I used to ask myself that same question every morning before I resigned myself to the fact that we’re never going to escape from this school year to begin with and-
scene sportstrivia11
: Blah, blah, blah — let’s get this show on the road, shall we?
: Do you think we should let Good Kid in? I feel kind of bad watching them play outside of the window. They look hungry.
: They’ve been trapped inside of Kumon-mi for years now! I’m sure they won’t mind being trapped outside of the school for a little longer. Besides, we’ve got bigger fish to fry!
: Io! Makoto! This year’s contest will work just like the last one we did- but with one caveat! You get to choose the category your opponent answers a question from!
scene sportstrivia12
: You’ll answer questions one-by-one until someone reaches ten points.
: And if you both reach ten points in the same amount of turns, we’ll have sudden death rounds until one of you answers correctly and one of you doesn’t.
: Now, tell ‘em what they’ll win if they make it through the whole contest without getting a single question wrong!
: Nothing. There is no bonus for that and I don’t know why Uta alluded to there being one in the first place.
: Gotta keep ‘em on their toes, Chika. You pick up tricks like this when you’ve been a contest host for as long as me.
: Well, Miss Host, do you think you can maybe pick up the pace a little? Because we’ve got the obstacle course after this and I’m going to need a little more help setting stuff up for that.
: Roger that, Imani! And since losers always go first, we’ll let Makoto choose Io’s first subject to kick things off!
scene sportstrivia13
: Bioengineering.
: What?! Isn’t that a little too specific?!
: The heck even is that? That ain’t a thing we learn in school. I thought we were sticking to school subjects?
: Imani, are advanced topics off limits? Or can we ask Io some kind of...bioengineering question?
: I’ll allow it! Ask away, girls! Let’s put Io’s bioengineering knowledge to the test!
scene sportstrivia14
: I don’t have any!
: I do. But of course I’m missing out on one more opportunity to show everyone how brilliant I am.
: Just give me the loss already! This is ridiculous!
: How the heck do you even spell-
: Here! I found a question.
: Io, the use of living systems and organisms to develop products is known as what?
scene sportstrivia15
: Is...Is it not just bioengineering?
: Crap! How’d she know that?!
: She didn’t. It’s biotechnology. It involves the application of biological knowledge and techniques to various fields such as agriculture, medicine, and industry.
: Yeah, that’s what I meant.
: Bzzt! Answer not accepted.
scene sportstrivia16
: Phew! Had me goin’ there for a second. Thought Io actually knew that one.
: Yeah well, sorry to be a disappointment, but I’m kind of a disappointment.
: That was a fair guess, though. It definitely could have been a trick question with the way it was worded.
: Don’t dwell on it, Io! Just choose a topic Makoto won’t know about and get back at her the good old fashioned way!
scene sportstrivia17
: I’ll take “being tolerable” for 500, Alex.
: You got this, Makoto! You’re super great at bein’ tolerable!
: Io, come on. Choose a real subject.
: Fine. Sports.
scene sportstrivia18
: Shit.
: Makoto! To take the lead, who is the all-time home run leader in the NPB?!
: Well, that’s...
: Just pass, Makoto. You ain’t gotta know everything.
: No, I...uhh...
: Shohei Ohtani?...
scene sportstrivia19
: Ohtani?!?! Are you even Japanese?! That’s light years worse than my answer!
: I don’t watch baseball. How was I ever supposed to know that?
: Ohtani only played in the NPB for five seasons! He would have had to hit over 170 home runs every single year to break Sadaharu Oh’s record of 868!
: Is that...Is that a lot?
scene sportstrivia20
: Can I leave now?! I can’t be around these people anymore!
: I like Ohtani...he seems like a good boy...
scene sportstrivia21
: He is! But that doesn’t change the fact that he’s not even in the top 100 for home runs in the NPB! He only had 48!
: Yasu, you’re...aware of the existence of Shohei Ohtani?
: Of course. I’m Japanese.
: See?! Even Yasu knows and she’s Yasu!
: Ohtani could get it.
scene sportstrivia22
: Miss Imai!
: What? Is that really a controversial thing to say? Look at him. He’s adorable. And those arms? Sheesh.
: Yeah...
: Ohtani could get it.
scene sportstrivia23
: I rest my case.
: Yumi!
: I mean...he’s kind of the perfect guy, isn’t he? Like, could I even call myself straight if I said no to him?
scene sportstrivia24
: I have never been more proud than I am in this very moment.
: Yeah...he sure is dreamy, isn’t he?
: He’d be dreamier if he hit another 820 home runs! Now, can we stop fawning over the guy and get on with this contest already?! The amount of estrogen here is suffocating me!
scene sportstrivia25
: R-Right! Makoto! Choose Io’s next subject!
scene sportstrivia26
: Attack her where it hurts, Makoto! Hit her with “public speaking!”
: Please don’t.
: How about...economics?
: That the fancy word for “public speaking?”
: No, it’s the fancy word for “money stuff.” And fine. It’s not a strong suit, but it’s easier than bioengineering at least.
: We’ll see about that, Io.
scene sportstrivia27
: I bet I’ll know this one too.
: Careful. Your ego’s showin’, Princess.
: Io, please describe what the phrase “Paradox of Thrift” means.
: Paradox of...Thrift?
: Isn’t that the idea where, like...if everyone starts saving their money, it will have negative effects on the economy? Since businesses need money in order to function and whatnot?
: Uhhhhh maybe? I haven’t read the answer yet but that sounds kind of-
: Oh, shit.
scene sportstrivia28
: Yeah, that’s...that’s basically what that means. Huh.
: I’m surprised you actually knew that.
: Can you be surprised in a way that doesn’t involve you making eye contact with me?
: Probably. But that would defeat the purpose of trying to understand you better and leave you with no one to talk to but Uta.
: Yeah, exactly. That’s the whole point.
: So you want to be lonely?
: Nah. She just is lonely because she talks shit on everyone and everything for no reason whatsoever.
scene sportstrivia29
: I do apologize if I’m misunderstanding, but...is that not what you do as well?
scene sportstrivia30
scene sportstrivia31
: Yumi’s just misunderstood. Meanwhile, Io wants everyone to dislike her.
scene sportstrivia32
: Hey. That’s...
: Why did you have to say that? Io didn’t do anything.
: She’s been complaining about being in the same room as all of us since the contest started. Are we not allowed to respond to that?
: I wouldn’t have to complain at all if everyone just left me alone.
scene sportstrivia33
: We literally do. Every day. Yet you still look down on all of us. But I like your friend, so I’m going to leave it at that.
: Okay, that’s enough with the hostility for now. Can you guys get back to asking questions, or do we need to take a quick recess and remember that today is supposed to be fun?
scene sportstrivia34
: Maybe my idea of “fun” is just a little different from everyone else’s. But, personally, I don’t find anything enjoyable about being forced to participate in-
: Foreign language is another weak point of mine.
scene sportstrivia35
: Huh?
: If you’re trying to stump me, I mean.
: You want to get out of here, don’t you? The fastest way to do that is either by winning or losing.
: But just because I gave you a hint this time, don’t expect me to roll over and go down without a fight.
: Even if there’s no true prize this year, a competition is still a competition. And I’m not going to take it easy on you just because you have social anxiety.
scene sportstrivia36
: It’s way more than just social anxiety, you know. And I’m not asking you to take it easy on me. I don’t need your pity.
: Well, that works out then. Because there are plenty of people I’d pity before you.
: The air within the room has changed.
: I can hear the sounds of their hearts bouncing off of the walls. They plead to be embraced and long for the removal of the chains that bind them.
: Do you...have a solution, Yasu?
scene black
: She must ask her about “biology.”
Fifteen minutes later...
scene sportstrivia37
: Why? Why did I think listening to someone would actually be a good idea this time?
: It seemed like a good idea to me.
scene sportstrivia38
: Yeah, because you won. And now we’ve gotta figure out a way to take another lead before y’all wind up getting points deducted for Maya’s mysterious disappearance.

: Final score — Makoto 10, Io 7. And with Imani officially overseeing the contest, the first floor will now receive their point, which ties the score of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB at one point each.
: For now, at least...Maya isn’t answering her phone. And I’m starting to think she won’t be competing at all.
: That’s exactly what I said earlier. She ain’t comin’ back. I know “aimlessly wanderin’ around” when I see it.
: Maybe she wasn’t feeling well? Or-
: That’s exactly what it was.

jump sportswars5
